_description: Known HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities pending major framework upgrades. Each entry must have a tracked remediation and a target_date. Review monthly and remove entries as they are fixed. Adding an entry here means committing to a remediation plan — it is NOT a permanent exemption.

_sla.high: 30 days from discovery; entries here have an approved extension

entries.advisory: GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c — sprintf-js DoS via unbounded precision specifiers (CVSS 5.3)
entries.scope: devDependencies only — jest coverage toolchain, NOT present in production runtime (npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 vulnerabilities)
entries.reason: sprintf-js@1.0.3 is a transitive dep of @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config used by ts-jest for coverage. No viable fix: npm audit suggests ts-jest@29.1.2 which is a downgrade from 29.4.14 and does not actually remove sprintf-js. The vulnerability is only reachable via crafted format strings in jest coverage reporter context — not deployable attack surface.
entries.remediation: Monitor @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config for a release that drops sprintf-js or upgrades to >=1.1.4. Alternatively, evaluate dropping nyc/istanbul coverage from ts-jest config if coverage is run via a different tool.
